# Hi, I'm Eugeni!

::: {.lead}
I’m a mobility researcher with a background in environmental management, transport planning and data analytics — oh, and I studied law too. I’m passionate about cycling, data visualisation and maps, which shape my research on how people move through cities and how the built environment influences travel choices. 

I'm currently based at [GEMOTT](https://gemott-uab.cat/en/) (*Research Group on Mobility, Transport and Territory*), within the [Department of Geography](https://www.uab.cat/en/geography) at the [Universitat Autònoma de Barcelona](https://www.uab.cat/).

This website brings together my research, publications, materials and field observations — feel free to explore, or get in touch.
:::
